title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by the equation: $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. We need to determine which function f(x) allows us to fit the data points in the scatterplot.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. The data points appear to follow a quadratic pattern. Consider which function f(x) would allow the model to fit this pattern.

title: Choosing the Function
text: Given the quadratic pattern in the scatterplot, which function f(x) would allow the model to fit the data? Consider $$f(x)=x^2$$.

title: Selecting the Correct Function
text: Based on the quadratic pattern, select the function f(x) that allows the model to fit the data: (A) $$f(x)=-x$$, (B) $$f(x)=x$$, (C) $$f(x)=x^2$$, (D) $$f(x)=|x|$$, (E) None of these.
